_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.description: Reconstruct the public 69,370 BTC forfeiture complaint as typed chain events and a trace graph; distinguish court allegations, on-chain observations, interpretations, and gaps; every fact has a source link and capture identity; attribution is graded and does not identify a natural person from an address.
requirements.title: Source-linked public case reconstruction

validation.notes: Run the published-case vertical slice with source fixtures; verify every occurrence joins to its primary court citation and public BTC transaction/block evidence, and verify the packet separates allegations, observations, interpretations, grades, and gaps.

requirements.description: Create and review local-only cases and redacted tip-ready evidence packets with source citations, counter-explanations, unresolved gaps, and explicit grades; no automatic submission, public publishing, contacting, or accusation is available.
requirements.title: Private case and packet boundary

validation.notes: Inspect the packet export and local-storage boundary; verify redaction defaults, source citations, counter-explanations, unresolved gaps, and the absence of network submission/publishing code paths.

requirements.description: Define versioned chain-neutral case, occurrence, asset, source, flow, bridge-message, cluster, attribution, and packet types plus deterministic graph operations in an importable Go package; the API and CLI consume the same typed model.
requirements.title: Reusable typed graph contract

validation.notes: Compile and exercise deterministic Go package tests for typed case/event/flow identity, provenance, evidence grading, graph expansion limits, and identical API/CLI serialization.
